intended_object: A non-canonical, choice-based walk (in fact a shortest path) from a chosen root of the connected component of v to v. The module documentation describes it as scaffolding for statements that integrate quantities along root paths.
explanation: The definition uses Exists.choose on Reachable.exists_path_of_dist to pick a walk from componentRoot G v (itself chosen with Set.Nonempty.some) to v. This matches its docstring: it is a walk of the right type, and in fact a path of length equal to the distance. It is stated for an arbitrary SimpleGraph, so it is not too narrow. But it is an arbitrary choice that the module explicitly calls "scaffolding" for later integration statements, not a standard mathematical notion. Mathlib has no canonical declaration for it; the nearest constructions are Reachable.exists_path_of_dist and ConnectedComponent.nonempty_supp.
